risks: The W1-03 roster sits in a fixture shared by six suites. I checked W1-45, W1-38 and W2-72 (unchanged) and W1-47 and W1-50, but not every other user. The W1-46 roster prepends the key to this repository's copied roster, so a future roster that begins with `---` would break that order.
lessons: Before editing a shared support module, check which suites import it and take their baselines first. For W1-03's baseline here I had already edited, so I set the diff aside as a patch with `git apply -R`, ran the baselines and re-applied it. I also used a here-document once (an empty scratch file) before remembering the rule; I did not use it again.
